main_text.l: stjme winnjkum nafsim : Ynev woʒ nâs w pokusserj: ale zbaw nàs od zleho : nebo twé gest kr·álowstwj, y moc,y slawa na weky, Amen.

l.i: Eadem Illyricè vel Slavonicè, ex libro Bartolo-mæi Georgeuitz de afflictione Christianorum subTurcis, impresso Vuormaciæ anno 1545 à cujus initio alia etiam ad hanc lin-guam pertinentia scribuntur:

main_text.l: Otesse naszky iefsi na nebeszi: Ssuetisse i-me tuoje: Pridi tuo kralyeuss: Budi voliá tuoia,kako na nebu,i na zem lij. Kruha nas-sega ssagdaniega dai namga danasz. Iodeu-scia nam dughe nafse, kako i mi odpuscia-uam dufnikon nafsim: Inepeliai nats u na-past,da izbaui nats od nepriaz ni, Amen.

Oczicz nasch krory iestosz wnyebye,Swyecz sie gymye tvá.Przdzy twi krolieswo.Bandz wolya iwa yako wnyebi,y na zemij.Chlieb nasch pow schedny day nam dzy say.A odpuscz nam uyny nascha, yako y my od-pusczamy wynowaytzom naschym.Nyewodz nas napokuschenye.Alye zbaw nasz od zlego. Amen.

page.notes: The first line of the Latin text is a fragment continued from the previous page. "woʒ" is a Slavic letter form I could not match exactly; "[?]" was not added but the reading is uncertain. The Polish verse spelling is old and irregular, copied as printed. "Oczicz" and "twi" are uncertain readings. The Latin title is set in italic and the Polish heading is set in italic.
